cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Recognize Me
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll keep dinner on schedule. Before dessert, please thank the person who cooked it all.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone knows it was you. We can't stop for another speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No speech. One sentence while I bring the plates through will fit my schedule perfectly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. I'll say the buffet was made by you. How do I pronounce your surname?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll say it quietly for you first. Then use it once, clearly, while I set the dessert down. That will give me my cue as well as my credit.

reason: Make A maintain service-management confidence by reducing acknowledgment to a practical cue, using B pronunciation question for cooperative preparation rather than an imperious correction.
